sentences.en: I would appreciate any information you can send to us.
sentences.zh: 如果您能给我们提供任何信息，我们将不胜感激。

sentences.en: I am not such a fool but can appreciate it.
sentences.zh: 我不是傻瓜，懂得欣赏这一点。

sentences.en: We would appreciate it if you grant us this concession.
sentences.zh: 如果能得到您的特许，我们不胜感激。

phrases.zh: 如果你能做到/愿意……我们不胜感激

senses.zh: 感激, 感谢欣赏, 赏识, 重视意识到, 体会

mnemonic: 词根记忆：ap（加强）+preci（价值）+ate（做）→对价值给予肯定→赏识
